title: Playdough Animals — Sculpting God's Creatures
objective: Students will sculpt animals from playdough to celebrate the variety of creatures God created.
content: God made so many wonderful animals! Big elephants, tiny ladybugs, slithery snakes, and fluffy bunnies. Every animal is different and special.
Today we get to be creators too! We can use playdough to make our own animals. We can roll it, squish it, and shape it into any animal we want.

When we shape animals with our hands, we can think about how God carefully designed each creature. He gave birds wings to fly, fish fins to swim, and rabbits soft fur to stay warm. God is so creative!
activity: Use playdough to sculpt your favorite animal. Roll balls for the body and head. Add legs, ears, and a tail. Make as many different animals as you can! Tell a friend about the animal God made that you like best.
discussion: What animal did you make with your playdough?
What makes your favorite animal special?
Why do you think God made so many different animals?
